Our focus

FT PVT. LIMITED is the company behind All Document Reader. Our focus is a straightforward mobile experience for opening, reading and organizing supported documents.

We believe product information should be just as accessible as the product itself. That is why you can find features, supported formats, privacy information and a direct support contact together on this website.
